validity.recommendation: Reconcile P4054 against P1845 (Taji-South Baghdad Gas Pipeline) and P4066 (Trans-Iraqi-Daura Gas Pipeline) before treating it as a distinct line; most likely the same physical 18-in Taji->south-Baghdad(Dora) gas line entered under a map label. If confirmed a duplicate, merge names into OtherEnglishNames and retire the redundant row.
validity.researcher_notes: Duplicate risk is the single biggest problem with this row. Duara/Daura/Dora is the district in SOUTH Baghdad (Dora refinery + Al-Dora power complex). P4054 'Taji-Duara' (Taji -> Dora, dia=18) is geographically identical to P1845 'Taji-South Baghdad Gas Pipeline' (Taji -> Baghdad, dia=18, len=56). Both start at Taji (north Baghdad), both terminate in south Baghdad, both 18-inch -> very likely one physical pipe recorded twice from different source vintages (P1845 updated 2022-07-26, P4054 updated 2024-08-15). The wildly different capacities (P1845 cap=2.00 MMcf/d vs P4054 cap=94.00 MMcf/d) are not evidence of two pipes; 2.00 MMcf/d is implausibly small for an 18-in trunk and looks like a data error on P1845. Secondary overlap: P4066 'Trans-Iraqi-Daura Gas Pipeline' (dia=18, len=29) shares the Dora terminus and 18-in size and may be the southern segment of the same corridor. Could not clear the duplicate with an independent source because no independent source names any of these lines individually.

validity.recommendation: Treat existence as single-source until an independent Iraqi Oil Ministry / North Gas Company / press source naming a Taji->Dora dry-gas line is found. Search SOMO/Ministry of Oil and Iraqi press in Arabic; if none, downgrade confidence and consider merge per the duplicate finding.
validity.researcher_notes: The gem.wiki page cites exactly ONE source ([1], backlinks=4) for EVERY field: the 2018 Iraq Energy Forum presentation by Dr. Jafar D. Jafar (Uruk Engineering), iraqenergy.org/.../Jafar-Dhia-Jafar-URUK.pdf. I extracted that PDF with pdftotext: page 8, a network MAP titled 'Iraq's Existing Dry Gas Pipeline Connects North & South', carries the label 'Taji-Duara Gas Pipeline' (alongside 'Eastern Gas Pipe Line / 48 Inch, 350 mmscfd' = P4058). So the line is named by a credible primary source and is a real segment of Iraq's north-south dry-gas backbone -- it is NOT a fabricated phantom. BUT: (a) it is a single map label from one 2018 slide deck, (b) no independent source I searched (Iraq Business News, iraqieconomists.net/Al-Jibawi 2025, EIA, Lexology, Arabic Ministry of Oil / North Gas Company / attaqa / aljazeera) names a 'Taji-Duara/Dora' gas pipeline, and (c) the gem.wiki categories are unedited stubs ('Proposed pipelines in Country A / Existing pipelines in Country B'), indicating a low-effort entry. Fails the 2+-independent-source bar; existence rests on a single origin that is also the sheet's only citation.

validity.recommendation: Flag Diameter=18 in and Capacity=94 MMcf/d as unsupported orphan values and their [ref] cells as effectively orphaned. Do not keep the Jafar PDF as their [ref]. Re-source or blank; note the PDF's own '16-inch pipeline to the South (Taji)' phrasing.
validity.researcher_notes: Diameter=18 and Capacity=94 MMcf/d are NOT in the cited PDF. pdftotext of the full deck shows '18' appears ONLY inside the year '2018' and '94' appears ONLY inside '194,000 BOED' (crude burned for power) -- neither is a pipe spec. The map slide gives an explicit '48 Inch, 350 mmscfd' for the Eastern line but NO diameter/capacity for the Taji-Duara label. The worklist's earlier Diameter check that returned '200 + expected content present' is a false positive: url_verifier substring-matched '18' in the PDF's raw bytes, not a stated 18-in spec (I re-ran it -- the verifier cannot match ANY pipeline token, e.g. 'Taji', 'Duara', 'Gas Pipeline', in this PDF because the text lives in compressed content streams). Independent evidence contradicts rather than supports: the same PDF elsewhere states 'interruption of 16-inch pipeline to the South (Taji)', i.e. the North-Gas dry-gas line toward Taji is 16-in, not 18-in. No independent source corroborates either the 18-in diameter or the 94 MMcf/d capacity. Both values are unverified; their [ref] should not be the Jafar PDF.

validity.recommendation: Reconsider FuelSource='Taji': Taji is the northern delivery/transit node on the corridor, not a gas source. The gas source is northern dry gas (North Gas Company) fed down the North-South backbone. Owner='Iraq Ministry of Oil' is plausible but unsourced (likely North Gas Co / State Co. for Gas Filling); leave as deliberate-divergence flag, do not overwrite.
validity.researcher_notes: FuelSource='Taji' conflates the start location with a gas source -- the PDF map shows Taji as the mid-network hand-off between the northern dry-gas system and the Baghdad/south leg, and separately notes gas 'to the South (Taji)'. Owner 'Iraq Ministry of Oil' at 100% is consistent with a state dry-gas trunk but has no citation on the row and no independent confirmation for this specific line; operationally these lines sit under North Gas Company / gas-filling entities under the Ministry. Attribution is plausible but unsupported; flagging rather than overwriting per SOP.

validity.recommendation: Keep classification as gas transmission if the row survives the duplicate review; the one confirmable fact is that the cited primary source classifies it as part of Iraq's existing DRY GAS (transmission) backbone, not an oil/NGL line.
validity.researcher_notes: CLASSIFICATION is the one thing that checks out. The Jafar/Uruk map explicitly files 'Taji-Duara Gas Pipeline' under 'Iraq's Existing Dry Gas Pipeline Connects North & South' -- a gas transmission trunk, correctly NOT one of the GulfPub Iraq crude/NGL lines (none of which is a Taji-Dora gas line). Fuel=Gas and PipelineType=transmission are therefore correct. This is the only field cluster I can affirm; existence/duplicate/spec/attribution all carry the concerns above.

fills.researcher_notes: No independent, verifier-passing source found for 94 MMcf/d. The value is not in the sheet's only cited source (94 appears there only inside '194,000 BOED'). Left unresolved; see spec concern.

Diameter=18 in is unsupported: not stated in the cited PDF (18 there = the year 2018), the PDF instead references a 16-inch line toward Taji, and no independent source confirms 18 in. Prior verifier PASS was a raw-byte false positive. Left unresolved; existing [ref] is effectively orphaned.
Length genuinely blank. Corridor Taji->Dora is ~45-55 km (cf. duplicate-candidate P1845 len=56 km), but no citable independent source gives a length for this named line. Not forcing a number.

routes.start_name: Taji (north Baghdad; dry-gas network hand-off node)
routes.end_name: Al-Dora / Daura area, south Baghdad (Dora refinery + Al-Dora power complex)

waypoints.name: Baghdad metropolitan area (corridor transits the capital N->S; exact alignment unknown)

routes.corridor_desc: Runs generally north-to-south down the Baghdad governorate: from Taji (~25-30 km north of central Baghdad) to the Al-Dora/Daura district on the south side of the city (Dora oil refinery and Al-Dora thermal/gas power stations). Straight-line ~28 km; a routed alignment skirting/through the metro is plausibly ~45-55 km, consistent with the likely-duplicate P1845 'Taji-South Baghdad' length of 56 km. Endpoints are named at town/facility scale and independently verifiable; the intermediate alignment is NOT sourced -- treat as a loose Baghdad-governorate corridor, not a traced route.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from the pipeline NAME (Taji -> Duara/Dora) plus the Jafar/Uruk map placing the line on the north-south Baghdad dry-gas backbone. The two proposed_refs are verifier-passing and confirm the ENDPOINTS exist as real Baghdad-area places (Taji town north of Baghdad; Al-Dora power station in Dora, south Baghdad) -- they do NOT independently confirm the pipeline between them. Coordinates are approximate, decimal-degree EPSG:4326, defensible from these named, well-known places (Taji town center ~33.52N 44.23E; Dora refinery/power complex, south Baghdad ~33.27N 44.40E); no coordinate was fabricated and the intermediate waypoint is an approximate metro transit point, not a sourced vertex. If the row is merged into P1845 per the duplicate finding, transfer this corridor there.

summary: P4054 Taji-Duara Gas Pipeline: CONCERN (duplicate of P1845 / overlap P4066; existence single-source 2018 Jafar-Uruk map only; Diameter=18 & Capacity=94 NOT in cited source and uncorroborated; FuelSource=Taji is a node not a source). Classification (gas transmission) is the only confirmable field. Suggested route accuracy: low (Taji->Dora Baghdad corridor, endpoints verified, alignment unsourced).
